data.body: Epic 7e9e: BLOCK x3 CRITICAL. T1+T3 demanded empirical proof that ModelSettings.extra_headers reaches the wire through rebar's OWN provider path rather than a docs claim. RAN THE SPIKE: pinned pydantic-ai 1.107.2; settings.py declares extra_headers dict[str,str]; models/openai.py reads :1001 forwards :1034; drove ProviderSession.model_for('openai:gpt-4o') with base_url through _build_openai/_RebarOpenAICompatibleProvider, intercepting at the httpx.AsyncHTTPTransport seam providers.py documents. RESULT: request hit <base_url>/chat/completions with x-litellm-trace-id and x-corp-tag both verbatim on the wire and Authorization: Bearer k intact. Capability verified, auth-preservation confirmed. Recorded in the epic with citations. Also fixed COH/E1: criterion 7 (omit-on-absent-substituend) now assigned to the delivery child. Incidental: pydantic-ai deprecation warning — 'openai:' resolves to Responses API in v2.0, use 'openai-chat:'; out of scope, noting for later.
